definitions.explanation: The traditional sport of hunting game with a trained hawk or falcon, historically practiced by nobles and samurai.

examples.japanese: {鷹狩|たかが}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
⟦{殿様|とのさま}→殿様：10455_tonosama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鷹狩|たかが}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧、{鷹狩|たかが}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{将軍|しょうぐん}→将軍：12386_shougun⟧や⟦{大名|だいみょう}→大名：10378_daimyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特権的|とっけんてき}な⟦{娯楽|ごらく}→娯楽：00074_goraku⟧だった。
examples.english: In the Edo period, falconry was a privileged pastime of the shogun and feudal lords.

notes:
The traditional practice of hunting with trained birds of prey. In Japan it was long associated with the warrior elite and was strictly regulated.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鷹狩|たかが}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go out falconry hunting
- {鷹狩|たかが}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鷹|たか}→鷹：02218_taka⟧: a falconry hawk

USAGE:
The handler who trains and flies the birds is called a {鷹匠|たかじょう}; today the practice survives mainly as a demonstration of traditional skills.
